[SWS_DM_01971]
FDC
value for monitors without debouncing
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04068
⌈
If a monitor was initialised by
ara::diag::Monitor::Monitor
or ,
ara::diag::
MultipleMonitor::ConfigureMonitor
the DM shall derive the FDC value by the
following rules:
• -128 in case TestFailed=0 and TestNotCompletedThisCycle = 0
• 0 in case TestNotCompletedThisCycle = 1
• 127 in case TestFailed=1 and TestNotCompletedThisCycle = 0."
